content.text:
I checked the unit models this version offers against the case's units. It has no GAC adsorber, and none of the listed models do what a GAC contactor does. The case needs a Freundlich-isotherm adsorption model (CPHSDM) with EBCT, bed voidage and bed length, plus separate treated and adsorbed outlets. `syn001.component_separator` is a generic split. It has no isotherm or bed model, so using it would be a substitute, and I did not build one. The listed models also don't include the MCAS (multicomponent aqueous solution) property package.

The only separation unit is a generic component separator, which would be a substitute, so nothing was built."}, "claims": []}
